environment.description: Same Kubernetes cluster with Istio 1.20 service mesh in STRICT mTLS mode. An AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied to the 'data-pipeline' namespace that restricts which source principals can communicate with workloads. Specifically, the policy uses a DENY action with a rule matching source namespaces NOT in an allow-list. The Redis instance has Istio sidecar injection enabled with a PeerAuthentication policy requiring mTLS. Additionally, a Sidecar resource in the data-pipeline namespace limits egress to only *.data-pipeline.svc.cluster.local and istio-system. The worker pod runs with readOnlyRootFilesystem=true and an emptyDir volume for /var/lib/worker/extractions with a 512Mi size limit. A DENY-all AuthorizationPolicy is the baseline, with an explicit ALLOW only for source principal cluster.local/ns/api-gateway/sa/ingestion-gateway to reach the Redis workload.
